before_after_summary.before: EV-002 in 1.0.0-mvp-approved verifies DIRECT_COMMIT CANDIDATE generation on a default-branch commit with COMPLETED + NO_MATCH_OBSERVED and start/end branch verification, but omits the semantic expectation that NO_MATCH_OBSERVED is not proof of zero PRs and requires user association confirmation.
before_after_summary.after: Adds semantic direct_commit_confirmation_expectation (requires_user_association_confirmation=true, no_match_observed_means_definitely_no_pr=false) on ev_exp_002_1 while leaving unapproved API field names and UI badge strings explicitly UNCONFIRMED.

anchor_mode='DIRECT_COMMIT', lifecycle_status='CANDIDATE', version=1, 1-per-commit fallback, search_checks, and aggregation_check remain unchanged.
Existing approved cases/EV-002-default-branch-direct-commit.json and manifest.json SHA-256 hashes are NOT overwritten.

direct_commit_confirmation_expectation.semantic_note: NO_MATCH_OBSERVED only indicates that completed provider lookup observed no linked PR at snapshot time; it does NOT prove no PR exists. Surface a semantic user association-confirmation-needed indicator without assuming an unapproved API field name or UI badge literal.

events.title_hint: Hotfix: raise circuit breaker timeout from 2s to 5s on edge router

review_required_items.question: Approve adding the semantic user association-confirmation-needed expectation to EV-002 (next dataset version), while keeping exact API field name and UI badge string unconfirmed unless fixed in MVP API spec.
Decide whether to extend case.schema.json with direct_commit_confirmation_expectation (or a generalized review_guidance object) before bumping dataset_version beyond 1.0.0-mvp-approved.

rationale.summary: Amends EV-002 to express the B-001 / Direct Commit contract rule that NO_MATCH_OBSERVED means 'no PR link observed during completed lookup', NOT 'no PR definitely exists', and therefore the emitted DIRECT_COMMIT CANDIDATE must carry a semantic expectation that user association confirmation is needed. Deliberately avoids freezing unapproved API field names or badge strings.
